[h2]Tune in Details: Call of Duty: NEXT[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Join the global Call of Duty community for Call of Duty: NEXT, live at 9:00 AM PT on Friday, August 21. Serving as the command center for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], NEXT brings together reveals, developer insights, live gameplay, and creator broadcasts from around the world into one global event.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qeFVhw4YNbM;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]Immediately following NEXT, at 11:00 AM PT, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta officially launches. Deploy alongside players worldwide and be among the first to experience everything Weekend One has to offer. Return here tomorrow for more details on the Weekend One content.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: PC Specifications[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Planning to deploy into the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta on PC? Check your setup against the Minimum and Recommended PC specifications below to make sure you’re ready for the Beta.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/32041265bb850b70661a6811cc8cd99881434f90.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Minimum Specifications[/h3][p align="start"]The minimum PC specifications needed to play the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta:[/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10 64 Bit (latest update)[/p][/*][*][p][b]CPU:[/b] AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Intel Core i5-8400[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAM:[/b] 12GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – AMD:[/b] Radeon RX 470[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – NVIDIA:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / 1060[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – Intel:[/b] Intel Arc A580[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Memory:[/b] 3 GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage Space:[/b] SSD required[/p][/*][*][p][b]Network:[/b] Broadband Internet connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Card:[/b] DirectX Compatible[/p][/*][/list][h3]           [/h3][h3]Recommended Specifications[/h3][p align="start"]The recommended PC specifications to play the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta:[/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 11 64 Bit (latest update)[/p][/*][*][p][b]CPU – AMD:[/b] AMD Ryzen 5 3600[/p][/*][*][p][b]CPU – Intel:[/b] Intel Core i7-8700[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAM:[/b] 16 GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – AMD:[/b] AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – NVIDIA:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Card – Intel:[/b] Intel Arc B580[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Memory:[/b] 8 GB[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage Space:[/b] SSD required[/p][/*][*][p][b]Network:[/b] Broadband Internet connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Card:[/b] DirectX Compatible[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Recommended Drivers[/h3][list][*][p][b]NVIDIA:[/b] 610.47[/p][/*][*][p][b]AMD:[/b] 26.7.1[/p][/*][*][p][b]Intel:[/b] 32.0.101.8861[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Required for All PC Specifications[/h3][list][*][p][b]Internet:[/b] Broadband Internet connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] DirectX 12 compatible system[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Requirements:[/b] TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are required to play [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. Other security measures may be enforced. Players can run the Call of Duty Secure Attestation Wizard to verify that their PC meets our security requirements prior to Beta. [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/trusted-platform-module-and-secure-boot"][u]Click here to learn more at the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 and Secure Boot for Call of Duty Support Page[/u][/url].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Note:[/b] These specifications apply to the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta and may differ from the PC specifications for the full game at launch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]PC Players: TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot Requirements[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]PC players:[/b] Before Beta begins, make sure TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are enabled.
These Windows security features help establish a trusted foundation for RICOCHET Anti-Cheat™, especially for [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i] players, and make system-level tampering more difficult, helping protect the integrity of the Beta from Day One.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]If you have these features already enabled, you're ready for the Beta. If TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot isn’t enabled, you won’t be able to play the Beta online.
[/p][p align="start"]Need help getting set up? Watch our step-by-step guide here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="GLhNXlrUrvQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]PC: Shader Preloading Comes to the MW4 Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b] [i]Shader Preloading gets a head start on preparing your PC’s shaders before you launch Modern Warfare 4. The result? Less time waiting. More time playing.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cd59c7a91551190f88b01565f9100fe5faa2281.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]PC players:[/b] Shader Preloading is coming to the [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta, helping cut down the wait between launching the game and getting into your first match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Shaders: What Are They, and Why Do They Matter?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Shaders are small programs that tell your graphics card — or GPU — how to optimally render what you see on screen, from surfaces and lighting to shadows, visual effects, and more.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]On consoles, developers can optimize for a standardized hardware configuration. PCs are different, with a huge variety of graphics cards, drivers, and system configurations available. That means certain shaders need to be prepared for your specific PC [b]before they can do their job [/b]— [b]rendering graphics properly during gameplay.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]That’s where [b]Shader Preloading[/b] comes in. Shader Preloading prepares these shaders ahead of time, rather than waiting until they’re needed during gameplay. This reduces the amount of shader processing that needs to happen when you play, helping to minimize stutters and other performance hitches.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]What to Do Before You Drop into the Beta[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]With [b]Shader Preloading,[/b] the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta can get a head start by preparing shaders before you launch the game. Moving more of this process outside the game means less time waiting after you boot up, creating a faster route into your first match.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]During the Beta, you may see “Call of Duty®: [i]Modern Warfare® 4[/i]”[i] [/i]appear as a notification in your Windows system tray with a “Shader Pre-Loading Will Start” mention, after you’ve installed or updated your game. Don’t be concerned: this is expected behavior. It means MW4 is preloading shaders in advance so they’re ready when you are.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Shader Preloading uses some system resources while it’s running, but its impact is designed to be minimal. You can continue using your PC while the process runs in the background.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Prefer not to use Shader Preloading? This feature can also be disabled in your settings, and you can interrupt the preloading by right-clicking on this process without consequences, as the preloading will resume once you’re in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Shader Preloading Availability During Beta[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam[/b]: Shader Preloading will be enabled, but a one-time shader compile is still needed on first boot:[/p][list][*][p]First game boot – precompile shaders (similar to how it works today)[/p][/*][*][p]Game launches after subsequent updates – Shader Preloading takes effect[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]This means that for the MW4 Beta, Steam players who play during Weekend One will be able to use Shader Preloading for the Weekend Two update. After [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches, the benefit will be fully realized as we move into our regular seasonal update cadence, and players only need to compile shaders once.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Infinity Ward and Beenox have collaborated to bring Shader Preloading to [i]Call of Duty[/i]. Bringing the feature to the Beta allows us to see it working across the enormous variety of PC hardware and configurations in the community, giving the teams an opportunity to refine the experience where needed ahead of launch. We know you want to get into game as quickly as possible, and we will keep looking for ways to improve your experience for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The goal? Less time waiting. More time playing.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Update Requires Restart… Requires an Update[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL: [/b][i]For Modern Warfare 4, we’re reducing the number of situations where an update requires a restart. The experience varies by platform during the Beta, with further improvements planned for launch.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31d4c909b735825e18512bf902df61646a990f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you’ve played [i]Call of Duty[/i], you’ll definitely be familiar with “Update Requires Restart”: You launch the game, an update is applied, and you’re prompted to restart the game before continuing.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Many updates can already be applied without requiring that extra restart, including Playlist Updates, Store Updates, and other smaller updates that happen behind the scenes. With [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], we’re expanding this capability to include data patches — updates that make changes to the game without requiring a full Title Update — reducing the number of times you’ll need to restart… and see that infamous screen.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]There are still some exceptions. If you’re already playing [i]Call of Duty[/i] at the same time a new data patch goes live, you will still need to restart for the update to take effect. There are also some platform-specific differences during the Beta. Here’s what to expect:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]PC (Steam):[/b] Data patches will not require a restart in most situations. You may still need to restart if a data patch is released while the game is running.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]While “Update Requires Restart” isn’t disappearing completely, the goal is simple: fewer required restarts and fewer interruptions between you and your next match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Patch Notes Access[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL: [/b][i]Stay up to date throughout the Modern Warfare 4 Beta with the latest Patch Notes from the Infinity Ward Comms team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a12cecbeaf7e5f24eae4dc483841106cdedd00e3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect updates throughout the Beta covering everything from bug fixes and gameplay adjustments to new maps and modes. Visit the [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes"]Modern Warfare 4 Patch Notes[/url][/u] for the latest intel.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]MW4: Changes to the Install and Launch Experience for Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b] [i]For Modern Warfare 4, we’re changing how you install and launch the Beta. The Beta is a separate install from the main Call of Duty experience, allowing you to download and launch it directly from your platform.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This year, for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], we’re delivering the Beta outside of the main [i]Call of Duty[/i] install.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]With this change, players can now access and launch the MW4 Beta directly without needing to cross-launch through the main [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Since the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta is a separate install, it won’t download automatically as part of a regular [i]Call of Duty[/i]update. You’ll need to find the Beta on your platform and initiate the download separately.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Preloading the game begins August 20, so be sure to download ahead of time and be ready when the Beta opens. Exact times are listed later in this blog.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Launcher: What Happens at the Modern Warfare 4 Launch?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]When [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches later this year, the full game will remain part of the connected [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience, alongside [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™.[/i] Keeping the latest premium title and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] connected allows the games to share content where possible, helping reduce overall file sizes. It also means that when [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i]is updated with Season 1, you can easily switch between titles in the same session.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We’re continuing to look for ways to make the overall [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience simpler and easier to navigate. Before Campaign Early Access begins, we’ll introduce an updated UI and UX for the [i]Call of Duty[/i] install, including the work-in-progress look shown below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16b937ed7567662181467dce3ee154b26c3e3bc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This continues our focus on giving each [i]Call of Duty[/i] game its own distinct identity. [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches with an entirely redesigned UI, and you’ll get your first look at part of that new experience during the Beta.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Download and Launch the Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Whether you're joining your first [i]Call of Duty[/i] Beta or returning for another deployment, getting started is straightforward, no matter your platform of choice.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]What do I need to do first?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Before downloading the Beta, make sure you're ready to play.[/p][list][*][p]Sign in with your Activision Account[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Signing in with your Activision Account allows you to:[/p][list][*][p]Carry progression across supported platforms, letting you continue with the same profile if you play on more than one platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep eligible Beta rewards tied to your Activision ID.[/p][/*][*][p]Access earned Beta rewards when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches.[/p][/*][*][p]Continue your progression if you switch between supported platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Don't have an Activision Account?[/b] Create one here before launching the Beta to ensure your progression and eligible rewards are saved.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]When is the Modern Warfare 4 Beta Available to Play?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is available during two scheduled Beta weekends.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Early Access (Weekend One)[/i][/p][p align="start"]Early Access begins at 11:00AM PT, Friday August 21 for players who have pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] on Steam. The Early Access Beta is scheduled to end at 10:00AM PT on Tuesday, August 25.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here’s how to participate in the Early Access Beta:[/p][list][*][p]Pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] or[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Redeem a Beta Code[/p][p align="start"][b]TIP: [/b]If you can't find the Beta, confirm it's currently live for your platform, region, and Beta access window. Also, make sure that you’re eligible to play during Early Access via pre-order / pre-purchase or redeeming a Beta Code, or you may not be able to see the Beta on your platform of choice.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]How do I redeem a Beta Code?[/i][/p][p align="start"]For further information about redeeming a [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta Code, [u][url="https://support.activision.com/modern-warfare-4/articles/modern-warfare-4-beta-code-support"]read our support article here[/url][/u]. Beta Codes are only useful for the Early Access Beta.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Open Beta (Weekend Two)[/i][/p][p align="start"]The Open Beta begins at 10:00AM PT, Friday August 28 for players on Steam. The Open Beta is scheduled to end at 10:00AM PT on Tuesday, September 1.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here’s how to participate in the Open Beta:[/p][list][*][p]The Beta is available to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Download the [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta on your platform of choice.[/p][/*][*][p]No pre-order or Beta Codes are needed.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How do I Download and Launch the Beta?[/h3][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is downloaded separately through your platform's digital storefront. You can preload early before a Beta Weekend begins, or at any time during either Beta Weekend. Here’s how to accomplish this:[/p][list][*][p]Download and install the Beta, then launch the game once the Beta is live.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Can I preload the Modern Warfare 4 Early Access or Open Beta?[/h3][p align="start"]Providing you meet the participation criteria for the Early Access Beta (see above), you can pre-load the Early Access Beta starting at [b]9:00AM on Thursday, August 20[/b].[/p][list][*][p]All players can preload the Open Beta starting at 9:00AM on Thursday, August 26, on all platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are participating in both Beta Weekends, you only need to download the game once, as content and progression carries over from Weekend One to Two.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How do I download the Modern Warfare 4 Beta on Steam (PC)?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Download the Beta:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Launch Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Search for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Store page.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam automatically adds the Beta to your Library and begins downloading.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Launch the Beta:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Open your Steam Library.[/p][/*][*][p]Select [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Click Play (once the Beta is live).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Frequently Asked Questions about the Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bcdd7095d005255520db2d20406b6fdd33084bc1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]How can I find the Modern Warfare 4 Beta? I can't find it.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Confirm the Beta is currently live.[/p][/*][*][p]Verify your platform has access during the current Beta window.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart your platform's storefront.[/p][/*][*][p]Search again for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]If the Beta is in Early Access, ensure that you’re eligible to play via pre-order / pre-purchase or a Beta Code redemption[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]The Modern Warfare 4 Beta won’t launch. How can I fix this?[/i][/p][list][*][p]Check for available updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart your PC.[/p][/*][*][p]Confirm the Beta live window has begun.[/p][/*][*][p]Relaunch the application.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Will my Modern Warfare 4 Beta rewards be available in the full game?[/i][/p][p align="start"]Yes. Eligible Beta rewards (detailed below):[/p][list][*][p]Remain tied to your Activision Account.[/p][/*][*][p]Will be available when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches on October 23.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The following Beta progress does not continue after the Beta concludes:[/p][list][*][p]Player level (Rank).[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon unlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Other in-Beta progression.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Rewards[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Progress through the Beta, level up, and unlock new cosmetic rewards along the way.[/p][list][*][p]During Weekend One, the first five of the Rewards, up to “Dread Tiger” Operator Skin for Reece, can be unlocked, as the maximum Player Level you can progress to is Level 20.[/p][/*][*][p]During Weekend Two, all eight of the Rewards, up to and including the “Beta Forged” Weapon Blueprint for the ISO Nightshade SMG, can be unlocked. The maximum Player Level you can progress to is increased to Level 30.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]These rewards will not be available to earn after the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta concludes. All Beta Rewards that you unlock will be available in the full game when it releases on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p]Beta Rewards[/p][list][*][p][b]Level 4:[/b] “Through the Paces” Legendary Emblem[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 8:[/b] “First Served” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 12:[/b] “Meonjeo” Legendary Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 16:[/b] “Last Charge” Legendary Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 20:[/b] “Dread Tiger” Operator Skin – Reece[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 23:[/b] “Field Tested” Epic Spray[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 26:[/b] “Beta Rights” Epic Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 30:[/b] “Beta Forged” ISO Nightshade Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Additional Rewards[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]There's even more to unlock throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. Keep an eye out for additional cosmetic rewards earned through a variety of activities, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Default Items (immediately available):[/b] 3 Emblems, 3 Calling Cards, 1 Spray, and 3 Loading Screens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED] Charm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Record Rewards:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED] Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, and Charm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Call of Duty: NEXT and Modern Warfare 4 Beta Twitch Drops[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Tune in and earn rewards! Link your Activision account to your Twitch® account, then watch [b]Call of Duty: NEXT[/b][i] [/i]and participating [i]Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/i] streams to earn [b]cosmetic content awarded in-game at the launch of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i][/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6332e482645e9e7f177ea9ec2e38ea553f7abdb2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Call of Duty: NEXT Twitch Drops[/h3][list][*][p][b]“Gas Ready” Emblem [/b](for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Rapple Repel” Calling Card [/b](for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Ghost Helmet” Charm [/b](for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Modern Warfare 4: Beta Twitch Drops (not shown)[/h3][list][*][p][b]“Get Tactical” Emblem [/b](for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Clearing House” Calling Card [/b](for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Action Ready” Charm [/b](for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][u][url="https://support.activision.com/articles/managing-your-activision-profile"]For further details on linking your Twitch account, click here[/url][/u].[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Development Credits[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5® and PC via Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url] [i]for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]©/TM/® 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i]For more information, please visit [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][i] and [/i][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][i], and follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url][/u] and [/i][u][url="https://x.com/InfinityWard"]@InfinityWard[/url][/u][i] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url][/u] on X.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]Join [u][url="http://discord.gg/CallofdutyOfficial"]Call of Duty's Official Discord[/url][/u] to get the latest updates and maybe even meet your next squadmate![/i][/p]

newsitems.title: The International Main Event
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. From Twitch to YouTube to Steam, The International will be streamed on multiple platforms in multiple languages.[/p][list][*][p][b]Chinese[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]English[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Russian[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Spanish[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Online Secret Shop[/h3][p]Fans interested in purchasing swag from this year's offerings are welcome to purchase online. We have two shops available, depending on which part of the world you're in. Fans located in China can purchase through [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] and fans everywhere else can head over to [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url] to check it all out.[/p]

At the end of PGS 12, the top eight teams in the annual PGS Points standings will qualify directly for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]For the teams that built an advantage in the first half, Shanghai is where they must defend it. One strong circuit could reshape the entire PGC race.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Map Pool and Order[/h2][p align="start"]Circuit 3 will be played across Erangel, Miramar, Taego, and Rondo.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,,"][tr][th][p]Stage[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 1[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 2[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 3[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 4[/p][p][/p][/th][th][p]Match 5[/p][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Group Stage [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]— [/p][/td][td][p]— [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Winners / Survival / Final Day 1 / Grand Finals Days 1 & 3 [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]Rondo [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Final Day 2 / Grand Finals Day 2 [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][td][p]Erangel [/p][/td][td][p]Rondo [/p][/td][td][p]Miramar [/p][/td][td][p]Taego [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]The Group Stage repeats the same Erangel → Miramar → Taego order across all three group matchups for Matches 1 through 9.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Prize Pool[/h2][p align="start"]The total prize pool for Circuit 3 is $500,000, distributed across the three series.[/p][list][*][p]PGS 7: $100,000 — $30,000 for the champion[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 8: $100,000 — $30,000 for the champion[/p][/*][*][p]PGS 9: $300,000 — $100,000 for the champion[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Placement prizes will be awarded to the top eight teams in PGS 7 and PGS 8, and to all 16 Grand Finalists in PGS 9. Each series also features separate match-win and MVP prizes.[/p][p align="start"]Across four circuits and 12 series, the total prize pool for the 2026 PGS season is $2,000,000.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Watch[/h2][p align="start"]All PGS 7–9 matches will be broadcast live on official PUBG Esports channels.[/p][p align="start"]Matches begin at 10:00 UTC daily, except for the PGS 7 Group Stage on August 5, which begins at 05:00 UTC.[/p][p align="start"]Detailed broadcast channels and viewing links will be announced separately.[/p][p align="start"]A new city, double the points, and 24 teams fighting for their place at PGC 2026. Circuit 3 will set the direction for the second half of the 2026 season.[/p][p align="start"]See you in Shanghai on August 5![/p]

newsitems.contents:
[h1][u]Season 05 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h1][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Hit Harder. Hit Louder.[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Season 05 Reloaded keeps the action hot throughout the remainder of summer, highlighted by the grand finale of the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies storyline with the arrival of Rex Infernus. In Multiplayer, fight your way through a Nuketown-inspired pinball machine in Turbo Tilt and put your movement skills to the test in a brand-new Freerun course. In [i]Call of Duty ®: Warzone™[/i],[/p][p align="start"]Black Ops Royale is back, whileLoaded Resurgence joins in as a Weekend LTM and Endgame continues to challenge Operators with the Burn Run Assignment.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Plus, unlock new Attachments and the Mace Melee Weapon through additional Weekly Challenges, earn rewards across new in-game events, and more. Gear up and join the mayhem when the Mid-Season update arrives in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]on August 20 at 9AM PT.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]The Burn Continues:[/b] Kick up dust with the continuation of the limited-time Burn Run Assignment, challenging Operators to race through dozens of flaming checkpoints while knocking over enemies and obstacles and grabbing power-ups to help beat the clock.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Last Chance for Free to Play:[/b] Play Endgame for free through the end of Season 05. Invite your friends to join the squad and level up and earn rewards through the co-operative game mode’s multiple Operations.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Keep Up the Burn[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f83c1100bcbc075b5bf12a8f7e45b0677635e6bd.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Feel the burn throughout the Mid-Season as the limited time Burn Run Assignment continues to appear in Avalon in Season 05 Reloaded. Seek out the skull icon on your Tac Map and head to the site where you’ll find a Guild-rigged UTV ready to go. Climb inside and race the clock to the end, driving through checkpoints while facing enemies and obstacles on the road.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Hitting enemies and obstacles will add more seconds to the clock but watch out for the state of your vehicle. Pick up Repair power-ups along the way to keep the car from falling apart, and grab Boost power-ups to get ahead in the race.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]There are three Burn Run tracks in all, as follows:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Old Arsenal[/b] (Recommended Combat Rating N/A): Complete to earn 500 Power and a Random Reward.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]High Town[/b] (Recommended Combat Rating 30): Complete to earn 1,250 Power and a Random Reward.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Low Town[/b] (Recommended Combat Rating 45): Complete to earn 2,000 Power and a Random Reward.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Last Chance for Free to Play[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73863fe07a0763ddead02c60244a50f14d809e22.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p align="start"]Season 05 Reloaded is your last chance to play Endgame for free! Invite your friends and tear it up through Avalon while tackling Operations and other PvE challenges. At the start of Season 06, Endgame will no longer be accessible via the [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]menu and will be available only to [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]owners.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 05 Reloaded Multiplayer[/u][/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] Battle inside a massive pinball machine built from iconic Nuketown history as bumpers, ramps, and targets come alive in the brand-new Turbo Tilt Multiplayer map. Explore obstacles and locations from the infamous cul-de-sac while striving for a high score. Plus, undertake a new obstacle course in Freerun: Descent, offering rewards to Operators who prove their skill across seven zones of escalating mobility challenges.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Cranked Returns:[/b] In Cranked Moshpit, eliminate enemies to earn Operator buffs and start the Cranked timer. Keep slaying and stay on the objective to keep the timer, and your life, from running out.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][p][i]Turbo Tilt[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4a47bd61b74f40fa954af8f5d0fca7966b8e839a.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Celebrate the history of Nuketown as Operators enter the [i]Nuketown Turbo Era Rampage [/i]pinball machine hosted by Archie Atom. This fun-sized map is packed with callouts to the infamous cul-de-sac, including the Bus, a view from the House, the desert landscape, and the blast itself in the center where a mushroom cloud rises over action.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da1031e8f199454c865d4aebe7faa1c5330bc73f.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Fire at interactive targets, set off the Flippers, and watch out for pinballs bowling over Operators caught on the Track. From your scaled down perspective, marvel at the guts of the machine as you battle between open play spaces and the mechanisms running the game. In this homage to Nuketown, prepare for constant battle, using the map’s ramps, bumpers, and other features to stay ahead of the competition and reach that high score.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Freerun: Descent[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]New Course[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]“As early volunteers for the training program, you have a unique opportunity to prove your skills to the Guild. Finish before your competition if you wish to make a lasting impression.” [/i]— Dr. Atwood[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]There’s no rest for the weary as The Guild introduces a second Freerun obstacle course, in this case challenging Operators on a timed descent across seven zones with multiple checkpoints.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Each course run pits a team of ten Operators in a race to the finish, with every zone presenting its own unique challenges. From Wall Jumps to slides, Wingsuit sections, target training, Grappling Gun segments, and more, players must prove their total mastery over every obstacle. To keep the action moving, look for boost pads, portals, and shortcuts, anything to get ahead.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6969c3f1f48ca0e550d308690016854e91a8fa94.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Operators who fall off the course will acquire a fault and respawn at their last obtained checkpoint. Balance speed with precision to keep your total number of faults low, especially when going for the “Gridlock” Universal Weapon Camo. See the full list of course rewards below.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Freerun: Descent Course Rewards: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Complete the Freerun: Descent course three times to earn the “Eyes on Screen” Emblem and 1,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect all Ciphers in Freerun: Descent to earn the “Catch Air” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Finish the Freerun: Descent course in under 12 minutes with fewer than 10 faults to earn the “Gridlock” Universal Weapon Camo and 5,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Compete for additional rewards in the Mid-Season Freerun: Descent Challenge Event — including two additional Weapon Camos, a Weapon Charm, Weapon Blueprint, and more — detailed in the Season 05 Reloaded Events section found below in the General Content section of this blog.[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Cranked Moshpit[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Returning LTM[/i][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5bea6142493ba7441b065434518a03917019aa3.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Your life ends when the timer does in Cranked, the action-packed game mode where eliminating enemies activates Cranked mode, awarding Operator buffs while setting the timer in motion. Keep slaying and playing the objective to add more time. Hit zero and you explode.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Earn the following buffs for reaching killstreak milestones in each life:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]1-streak:[/b] Increased Movement and reduced Field Upgrade Recharge[/p][p align="start"][b]2-streak:[/b] Improved Hip Fire Accuracy and Increased Sprint to Fire[/p][p align="start"][b]3-streak:[/b] Increased ADS and Weapon Swap speed[/p][p align="start"][b]4-streak:[/b] Increased Reload Speed and Equipment Refill on Kill[/p][p align="start"][b]5-streak:[/b] Increased Score and Headshot Damage[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Obtain the double score buff earned at a 5-streak to skyrocket toward high-level Scorestreaks. Pummel the other team across a rotating playlist of objective modes including Cranked Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed, Hardpoint, and Demolition. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb205552d8281d07eb976948d3dc4c0cff3365b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u][b]Black Ops 7: Season 05 Reloaded Zombies[/b][/u][/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="center"][b]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Round-Based Zombies Map — Rex Infernus:[/b] Confront the Warden in the grand finale of the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies storyline as the crew attempts to save reality itself. Welcome to Rex Infernus, the next and final Round-Based Zombies map launching with Season 05 Reloaded.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Enemies, Trap, and Quest Rewards:[/b] Stand up to deadly Deathspinners and the Web Mother, swarming the crew with a mix of melee attacks and ranged web projectiles.  Smash foes to pieces with the aid of the new Titan Trap and earn rewards while taking on the Main Quest in Standard and Cursed Mode.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Features:[/b] Trap enemies in an explosion of webs with the new Widow’s Wine Perk-a-Cola and greatly empower your weapon with the Fully Packed Ultra GobbleGum. Dig through the Mystery Box in Rex Infernus for the chance to earn the new TR2 Marksman Rifle and Olympia Shotgun legacy weapons![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"] [/p][h3]New Map: Rex Infernus[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f343d7a7fba210f0a42a374ac7577400971b85d.jpg"][/img][/h3][p align="start"][i]“The end of your miserable lives is at hand” [/i]— The Warden[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]As reality stands on the cusp of destruction, the crew face their ultimate challenge. Cleanse the Shadowsmith places of power, find the Warden’s inner sanctum, and put an end to his loathsome existence.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53882b3b2adbc119cf31cc7deccb466ac3b37fc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Everything has led to this point, but does the crew have what it takes to finish the job and save reality? Answer the call to find out. There’s little known about Rex Infernus. Here’s what we’ve learned so far:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Rex Infernus: New Enemy: Deathspinner[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p]Prepare for a tough fight when Deathspinners approach.  These deadly creatures move quickly, strike fast, and use numbers to overwhelm the crew. They can also use a ranged web projectile that slows affected crew members. One on one, they’re not so bad, but watch out when they swarm.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Rex Infernus: New Elite Enemy: Web Mother[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1fd6c18c2cd3212d1e985f20529abb71b78095b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you think Deathspinners are frightening, wait until you run into the Web Mother. Try to keep your wits about you as the Web Mother screams and lunges, using copious amounts of webbing to damage and slow the crew while cocooning zombies transforming them into environmental hazards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Rex Infernus: Titan Trap[/i]

[i]Draws in nearby zombies and smashes them to pieces.[/i]

Pummel the enemy with the Titan Trap, calling upon the powerful force to slam their fists into the ground, damaging and disrupting zombies caught in the impact. Get out of the way fast when activating this trap or risk getting damaged by the Titan’s flurry hits. [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Rex Infernus: New Main Quest, Quest Rewards, and Challenges[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/af9efd92fdb4703b691cf3d5adbac920dd78b96a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The Main Quest for Rex Infernus will be available for play when the map releases with Season 05 Reloaded on August 20 at 9:00 AM PT. Complete the Main Quest to earn the following:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]The “Bloodthorn” Wonder Weapon Skin, Calling Card, and 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Obtain the necessary Intel (Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts) to earn another Calling Card and 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode arrives for this map will also earn a unique Calling Card variant.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Complete the Rex Infernus Mastery Challenge to earn an Animated Calling Card and 10,000 XP. Each map challenge awards XP and a static Calling Cards upon completion.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i][b]Tune Into the ZombieZone Livestream[/b][/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Follow along with the community as teams around the world race to solve the Rex Infernus Main Quest on August 20! Watch creators and community members go head-to-head live on the Rex Infernus ZombieZone livestream hosted by cbgray & evanf1997, along with special guest developers from Treyarch:
[/p][list][*][p]Twitch: [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/evanf1997"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]Twitch: [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/cbgray"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/cbgray"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/evanf1997"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Catch the pre-show countdown starting at 8 AM PT on August 20 live from Treyarch, then follow all the action starting at 9 AM PT until one team claims it all. Viewers on the ZombieZone stream can obtain a unique Twitch Zombies emblem by tuning in![/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i][b]Rex Infernus: Cursed Mode, New Pack-a-Punch Camos[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5446b2b646ddf74505cf454624fa562c33366c47.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Prove you have what it takes to defeat the Warden’s horde in even the most difficult situations with Cursed mode on Rex Infernus, offering no Main Quest guidance and a limited HUD and starting Pistol.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]New Perk-a-Cola: Widow’s Wine[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6ca788d8a5f7f74fe5797ab17ea14f7f27ab55a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]When melee attacks bring your health low, retaliate with an explosion of webs.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Major Augments:[/b][/p][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Widow’s Bite: [/b]Melee attacks have a chance to trigger a web explosion. Melee kills on cocooned enemies can overcharge your health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hatchling: [/b]Web explosions summon a friendly Deathspinner to fight for you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Web Spinner: [/b]A web explosion temporarily adds a slowing field around you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tangled Web: [/b]All Normal and Special enemies in the web explosion are cocooned in place, while Elite enemies are slowed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Minor Augments:[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Haste: [/b]Decrease Widow’s Wine’s cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Wide Web: [/b]Increases the web explosion’s effective radius.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Golden Orb Silk: [/b]Increase the duration of the webbing effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sticky Grenade: [/b]Thrown explosive Lethal Equipment will also cover surviving enemies in spider webs.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]New GobbleGum: Fully Packed[/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7eabae2a3ac996c1dc05bad1c7f06ea52a3faeae.jpg"][/img][/h3][p align="start"]Instantly upgrade your current weapon to Pack-a-Punch Level III with a bite of the Fully Packed Ultra GobbleGum.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Zombies:[/b] Upgrade your current weapon to Pack-a-Punch Level III.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Dead Ops Arcade:[/b] Receive a Tactical Armor Vest or a full complement of armor plates.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]New Ultra-Rarity Mystery Box Weapons[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7988ae1347afcfe1ac63e5bd99d66541411f84b9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p]Take on the final battle with the aid of two new Ultra-Rarity Legacy Weapons arriving in the Rex Infernus Mystery Box! Eliminate the undead from afar with the hard-hitting TR2 Marksman Rifle and shred them up close with the Olympia Shotgun. Each weapon features stats rivaling that of a Wonder Weapon, including full Pack-a-Punch progression and Ammo Mod capabilities.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][u]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Returning Game Mode and Mid-Season LTM:[/b] Black Ops Royale makes a triumphant returnfor  and drop into Loaded Resurgence arriving as a Weekend LTM.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Gameplay Features:[/b] Take on a Most Wanted Contract to secure the Quickdrop Kit, cutting down your squad’s redeploy time in Resurgence. And keep your eyes to the sky as Special Delivery Drones appear; bring one down and survive to claim new Weapon Camos.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][h3][i]Returning Game Mode[/i][/h3][p][i]Return to Avalon as Black Ops Royale arrives in the Mid-Season.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Black Ops Royale[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][i]Drop back into Avalon in the Mid-Season with this original Blackout-inspired Battle Royale with no Loadouts, no Gulag, and no Buy Stations. After wingsuiting in, it’s an all-out scramble to scavenge weapons, hunt for Attachment Kits to raise weapon rarity, and outlast 24 rival squads on this massive map.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i][b] [/b][/i][/p][p align="start"]Featuring a variety of enhanced objectives, dangerous zones with hallucinated zombie hordes, and only two ways to redeploy into battle, Black Ops Royale keeps the action varied and fast paced in a survival setting where the last squad standing wins. Gear up, control the chaos, and annihilate all rivals to survive.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Mid-Season LTM[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Loaded Resurgence joins the Mid-Season as the featured Weekend limited-time mode.[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Loaded Resurgence[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Resurgence Maps, 44 Players[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/65e8dad721c85dfcc3780a6fbf0bc07abadf58c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Drop into Rebirth Island, Haven’s Hollow, and Fortune’s Keep with your custom Loadout weapons equipped from the start and during redeploys. Perks, however, can only be earned through eliminations. Rack up enough kills to unlock the Specialist Perk and gain a powerful advantage as the match progresses.[/p][p align="start"]  [/p][h3]New Gameplay Features[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Reduce your squad’s redeployment time in Resurgence with the Quickdrop Kit and earn new Weapon Camos by shooting down the Special Delivery Drone.[/p][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][p][i]Quickdrop Kit[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Resurgence[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4a07e79f835831445a44fcba96070c8a5e7625b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Get back into the fight more quickly with the Quickdrop Kit, a stackable reward that reduces your squad’s redeployment time in Resurgence matches. Before acquiring the valuable item, you’ll first need to prove yourself by completing a Most Wanted Contract. Live through the ordeal to earn the Quickdrop Kit and maximize your squad’s time in the match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Special Delivery Drone[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Battle Royale, Resurgence[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a2e8999c2f43e6b529f7878518f94d5384c1d5df.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Look to the skies for the rare Special Delivery Drone. Ground it for the chance to earn new Weapon Camos, including the “Heavy Metal” Weapon Camo available across Verdansk and Avalon in Battle Royale and Battle Royale Casual, and the “War Machine” Weapon Camo available in Resurgence and Resurgence Casual.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: General Content (END, MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Weapons, Attachments:[/b] Get medieval and rush enemies with the new Mace Melee Weapon, combining long reach with high damage attacks to help break the enemy line. Other Weekly Challenge rewards include the RK-9 Calibrated Strike System and the Peacekeeper MK1 Gauss Accelerator.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Events:[/b] Face the Warden with Zombies-themed rewards including new Operator Skins and more earned in the Last Call Event, race through the Freerun: Descent obstacle course in a new Challenge Event and earn new Emblems and Weapon Camos through the [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Ranked Series event.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Store Offerings:[/b] The Mid-Season delivers new Bundles featuring premium content including Ultra Skins, Reactive content, and Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints, including a selection of Zombies themed Bundles providing the perfect sendoff for the final [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies map, Rex Infernus.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Melee Weapon: Mace[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Melee, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/121124f1bd2be34986ccc387d6f539a7a268b425.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Levels: 30[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Attachments: [/b]None[/p][p align="start"][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]Melee weapon. High damage, long range, and slow attack speed.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Swing at enemies with a massive two-handed Mace offering a long lunge distance with a slower downtime between swings. Take aim and crush your foes.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > Mace[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d69a1659424efd90109c083317f1529147d084e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Earn Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the Mace upon reaching Prestige 1, Prestige 2, and Prestige Max.[/p][p align="start"][b]  [/b][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments[/h3][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p][i]RK-9 Calibrated Strike System (In-Season)[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]RK-9 SMG, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Attachment > Barrel[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bc29f3ac130e5da554d0df5fd268a3a5d415495.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]Calibrated barrel paired with specialized bloom rounds that expand mid-flight and deal maximum damage when fired within a specific range. Includes an indicator to prompt the user when they are within that ideal range.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Peacekeeper MK1 Gauss Accelerator (In-Season)[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Peacekeeper MK1 Assault Rifle, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Attachment > Fire Mods[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0e4c662e6a2ad03d6e51f0981c597b53e40937ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]Heavy metal projectiles are accelerated to lethal velocity through a series of electromagnetic coils. Silently fires two projectiles at once with improved ballistics but harms overall handling and mobility.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]Season 05 Reloaded Events[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Get in your order in the Last Call Event, celebrating the arrival of Rex Infernus, the final Round-Based Zombies map in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. Plus, show off your parkour skills in the Freerun: Descent Challenge Event and earn new Emblems, Weapon Camos, and more in a new [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Ranked Series Event.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Event: Last Call (END, MP, ZM, WZ)[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Rewards Include: Operator Skins, Loading Screen, Weapon Charm[/i][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a0d5c84ca6e2a9fabf45346965fb88c385d00ee9.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Earn XP in Multiplayer, Zombies, Endgame, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] to unlock rewards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Free Track[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Unlock the Mace Melee Weapon, two Operator Skins, and other rewards just for playing! Earn XP to acquire the following Free track rewards:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]“Soph” Zaveri Operator Skin (Guild)[/p][/*][*][p]“Barber Beacon” Animated Emblem[/p][/*][*][p]“Mustachioed Man” Spray[/p][/*][*][p]“Six Pack” Sticker[/p][/*][*][p]1-Hour Double Weapon XP Token[/p][/*][*][p]“Next Customer” Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p]“Hair Die” Large Decal[/p][/*][*][p]“Nasty Nog” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Pass Tier Skip (X1)[/p][/*][*][p]“Trimmed” Richtofen Operator Skin (Guild)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Get More with the Premium Reward Track[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Upgrade to Premium to instantly unlock an Operator Skin. Progress to unlock an additional Operator Skin, three Weapon Blueprints, a Gun Screen, and more![/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]“Verrückt Original” Nikolai Operator Skin (Guild)[/p][/*][*][p]“Refreshing” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Buzz Cuts” Sokol 545 LMG Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]“Down the Hatch” Emote[/p][/*][*][p]“Flavor World” Echo 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]“Hatchet Work” Finishing Move[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Pass Tier Skip (X1)[/p][/*][*][p]“Kill Cap” Gunscreen[/p][/*][*][p]“Diabolical Dispenser” Voyak KT-3 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]“Wanderer” Vermaak Operator Skin (JSOC)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Event: Freerun: Descent Challenge (MP)[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Rewards Include: Weapon Camos[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Go for the fastest time in the new Freerun: Descent obstacle course! Face the many mobility challenges ahead and come out on top to earn the following rewards:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]“Bullseye” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][*][p]“Magnesis” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][*][p]“Free Run For All” Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Take Ten” Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“No Tripping” Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p]“Count to Five” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Sprint for the Finish” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Obelisk” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p]“Vibrant Aurora” Peacekeeper MK1 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Event: Call of Duty: Warzone Ranked Series (WZ) (In-Season)[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Rewards Include: Emblems, Weapon Camos[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e78d35ced2018736068b70df6a69b84cbee98bc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Compete in the Season 05 Reloaded [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]Ranked Play Event, featuring 50-player leaderboards with Emblem and Weapon Camo rewards for top placements across all Ranks. Secure Ranked Play wins to earn additional rewards including a new Weapon Charm and Large Decal.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]New Store Offerings[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Get your hands on a variety of new Ultra Skins, Reactive Skins, and Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints across incoming Season 05 Reloaded Bundles, including:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Tracer Pack: Lord of the Dead Ultra Skin Mastercraft Bundle[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f3d4abd8ea4dcf3173a36d19bada7e901c60435a.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Earn your right to reign in Rex Infernus and other Zombies maps with this kingly Bundle placing Dempsey at the top of the undead food chain. Rule with a golden fist using the following items:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]“Wildcat” Dempsey Ultra Operator Skin (JSOC)[/p][/*][*][p]“Tooth and Claw” FG42 Assault Rifle Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][*][p]“Gilded Fang” Swordfish A1 Marksman Rifle Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][*][p]“Golden Claw” Wonder Weapon Blueprint (Mastercraft)[/p][/*][*][p]“Raise Your Hands” Emote[/p][/*][*][p]“Crit King” Gun Screen[/p][/*][*][p]“Undying Liege” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p]“King’s Ride” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Rotting Majesty” Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p]“Wonderbar!” GobbleGum (x1)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Tracer Pack: Burn Directive Bundle[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/00be24ba6572ba57273f7beac860ffd58c2e470c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The heat is off the charts with this spicy Bundle prioritizing the burn over everything else. Deploy as a flaming hot Reaper EWR-3 and set things ablaze with the following Bundle items:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]“Flamin’ Hazard” Reaper EWR-3 Operator Skin (Guild)[/p][/*][*][p]“Too Hot” CBRS-3 SMG Blueprint (Tracers)[/p][/*][*][p]“Palate Scorcher” XM325 LMG Blueprint (Tracers)[/p][/*][*][p]“Contained” Emote[/p][/*][*][p]“Hot Shot” Lockshot Scorestreak Skin[/p][/*][*][p]“Hotter Than Hell” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Chili Bomb” Animated Emblem[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Tracer Pack: Infinite Void Reactive Ultra Skin Bundle[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/48808df4dce4b6105308f86b2ada7be4789653dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The universe is calling. Rip a hole in the fabric of spacetime with this Bundle featuring an assortment of items designed to thrust enemies into the void. Spin up your engines and explore the stars with the full Bundle contents, including:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p]“Vortex Pull” Takeo Ultra Operator Skin (JSOC)[/p][/*][*][p]“Sundered Reality” MK35 ISR Assault Rifle Blueprint (Reactive, Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][*][p]“Star Drive” MPC-25 SMG Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][/*][*][p]“Gravity Ray” Ray Gun Wonder Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]“Energy Shock” Finishing Move[/p][/*][*][p]“Planetary Defender” Sentry Turret Scorestreak Skin[/p][/*][*][p]“Stellar Spin” Reticle[/p][/*][*][p]“Ringer” Animated Emblem[/p][/*][*][p]“Perkaholic” GobbleGum (x1)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Other Incoming Bundles[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/083cae2e2d252b6479f9e1c7106dc6a2de63f275.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Visit the Store throughout Season 05 Reloaded for the above Bundles and more, including the “Tracer Pack: Stellar Dynasty Ultra Skin Bundle” featuring a royal Karma Operator Skin, “Tracer Pack: Stranded Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle” featuring a sand crawling Razor Operator Skin, and the Mil-Sim themed “Stick and Stones Bundle” led by a camouflaged Jurado Operator Skin.[/p][p][/p][h3]Verify Your Email and Unlock Double XP Tokens, Weapon Camo[/h3][p][/p][p]Unlock a wealth of Double XP plus the Universal Weapon Camo “Veiled Aurora” simply by verifying your email! Verifying your [i]Call of Duty[/i] account email helps strengthen security. Once you complete this verification, expect the following to be added to your Call of Duty Account:[/p][list][*][p]1 Hour 2XP Level Tokens (x5)[/p][/*][*][p]1 Hour 2XP Weapon Tokens (x5)[/p][/*][*][p]1 Hour 2XP Battle Pass Tokens (x5)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]For more info on email verification, [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/activision-account-email-verification"][u]visit our Activision Account Email Verification FAQ here[/u][/url].[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Then on August 20, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/verify-email"][u]click here to easily verify your email[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 7 Today![/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blackops7"][u]Purchase [i]Black Ops 7[/i] today[/u][/url] to access the entirety of the Season 05 Reloaded [i]Call of Duty[/i] experience, including Multiplayer and Zombies in addition to the free-to-play [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]©/TM/® 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc. [/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]For more information, please visit [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][i] and [/i][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"][u]@Activision[/u][/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"][u]@CallofDuty[/u][/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"][u]@CODUpdates[/u][/url] on X.[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Join [url="http://discord.gg/CallofdutyOfficial"][u]Call of Duty's Official Discord[/u][/url] to get the latest updates and maybe even meet your next squadmate![/i][/p]

[b]GREETINGS, FOOLISH MORTALS![/b]
 
The ghosts of the 9th-century British mafia have come to collect, and Merasmus has once again found himself burdened by a small, completely manageable debt that must be paid. Fortunately, he has devised an ingenious plan to avoid repaying it himself: [b]The Witching Hour contest![/b]
 
[b]The Witching Hour[/b] is a community-run Workshop contest, challenging creators to concoct brand-new Halloween spells for Scream Fortress. newsitems.title: The International: Predictions, Fantasy, and Supporter Bundles
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5c825b3d35627bfc4276c013745aa6fd4de935ea.png[/img]

Nearly a year has passed since Team Falcons hoisted the Aegis of Champions as the final team standing in Hamburg. But that was last year's story, and the time has come to turn our thoughts to Shanghai and the crop of competitors who vie to write the tale of [i]this[/i] year. All of their battles have brought them to the precipice. The International is just two weeks away.

After a decisive month of intense qualifiers, dominant performances from prior champions, and upset victories from up-and-comers, all sixteen teams have earned their invitations to this year's International.

Now it's time for us to extend an invitation to you.

We've just released an update featuring this year's TI-themed activities and item bundles. Not sure what that means? Keep reading for a handy guide to all the different ways to participate so you can find the content that's most interesting to you.

[list][*][b]I want to directly support my favorite teams and personalities.[/b][/list]
With supporter bundles for all sixteen teams and more than a hundred participating event talent, there's never been a better time to support your favorites. In addition to the four primary event languages, this year we're also offering community bundles for WXC Co. (Filipino), NS_ART (Brazilian Portuguese), and Maincast (Ukrainian). 50% of sales from supporter bundles (teams, talent, and community broadcasts) goes directly to the team or talent and 30% goes to the tournament prize pool.

[list][*][b]I want to show off that I supported my favorite team.[/b][/list]
Purchasing team supporter bundles of various levels will grant all kinds of things: custom sprays, a special badge for your health bar, custom team emoticons, custom chat wheel lines, and — new this year as a part of the Gold tier — a global effigy. This new building will replace your regular effigy through the end of September, allowing you to show your team support right in your base. Not supportive enough? You can purchase additional supporter levels that will upgrade the appearance of your effigy, including custom effects.

[list][*][b]I'm right about everything. Help me prove it.[/b][/list]
Predictions are back: How will the Swiss matches shake out? What about the bracket? Fun fact: Exactly zero have ever gotten the full Swiss stage results correct. Will you be the first this year? Not if you don't get your guesses in before the first match starts (10am CST, Thursday 8/13).

[list][*][b]I'm a huge fan of my favorite team but also I dislike all of their choices and wish I was in charge.[/b][/list]
We've got a new take on fantasy this year. We've introduced a new customization point: You. You're the coach, and can now assign custom modifiers to yourself that influence your whole team. We've also updated prefixes, suffixes, and the player drafting rules. You'll draft your perfect team in (mostly) pairs: both supports from one team, the safelaner and offlaner from one team, and then your favorite midlaner. 

[list][*][b]I am a Dota player and I'm already assuming I'll be the best at everything. What do I win?[/b][/list]
Like last year, awards will be granted to participating players based on their performance relative to everyone else. The Tyrian Regalia treasure is making a royal return with five refashioned Immortal items, exclusively available to the top performing players. New this year is the Terrain Token, which will allow winners to choose one of six returning custom terrains, including Reef's Edge and Immortal Gardens. Look for more information, including reward tiers and lots of details, in the Rewards section of the main Dota 2 menu.

[list][*][b]All of this is great but I did my predictions and my fantasy and supported the teams and talent already. What do I do [i]now[/i]?[/b][/list]
Good news for you: We also just shipped a new gameplay patch along with a ton of content fixes. Check out the [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]Summer Scrub 2026[/url] page for more details.

newsitems.title: Warframe creative director says Destiny 2's end is tragic, because even with hard work 'the business side of this industry always gets the last remark'
newsitems.author: Harvey Randall
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 isn't going anywhere, but it also isn't… well, going anywhere. The game's servers will still be running for the foreseeable future, but Bungie has since ceased updates to its flagship shooter to move onto other projects, tragically laying off much of its staff in the aftermath of that decision... Read more.

newsitems.title: Destiny 2 players get a final farewell gift from Bungie
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2 is done: The final patch is out, Bungie is decimated, and the game will remain playable but the story of one of the biggest, best and most influential online shooters ever is over. To memorialize the moment, Bungie has rolled out one last gift for players: A new emblem, free for everyone, called Gloriabundus... Read more.

newsitems.title: Former Destiny 2 and Marathon director settles $200 million lawsuit against Sony and Bungie: 'The outcome is one I am very satisfied with'
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Former Destiny 2 and Marathon director Christopher Barrett has settled his lawsuit against Sony and Bungie. Terms of the settlement were not disclosed, but Barrett implied a favorable outcome, saying he's "very satisfied" with it... Read more.

newsitems.author: flynnch
newsitems.contents:
[p]Over the past few days we've made various bug fixes and improvements:[/p]

[b]Dark Carnival[/b]
[list]
[*] Playing Regular and Turbo games now reward Scrap tickets. 6 Scrap can be traded for a Hero ticket of your choice. Regular games reward 2, Turbo games reward 1. Scrap is rewarded regardless of winning or losing.
[*] Seeing Stones can now be earned by playing Co-op Bot Matches on Hard and Unfair difficulties
[*] Candyworks now displays if an offered item is already owned
[*] The Dark Carnival Hero Filter button now shows a tooltip displaying the ticket requirement for the next reward
[*] Fixed the Ticket Trader not working after being unlocked for some players
[*] Fixed Ability Draft and cooperative bot matches not granting Tickets
[*] Fixed Candy Shop Rerolls granted from the Fortune Teller being capped by the weekly maximum
[*] Fixed Pick the Lock area gameplay changing with FPS
[*] Fixed Automaton Personas having the wrong hero chat wheel lines
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Players no longer need to select both high-demand roles in order to not spend a Role Queue Game for Ranked Roles. Instead, solo players need to select at least one of the high-demand roles in order to not spend a Role Queue Game.
[*] Innate abilities with an Area of Effect now correctly display their range in the world when hovering over the ability
